how_to_use: Each lens reweights the per-dimension similarity scores (the s_<dim> columns in scores_<target>.json). Overall score = weighted geometric mean: exp( sum(w * ln(max(s, 0.01))) / sum(w) ). Missing dimensions are skipped.

landing.label: Landing site rehearsal
landing.description: Terrain first: flat, smooth ground like the target, for testing landing hazard detection and plume-surface interaction.

rover.label: Rover testing
rover.description: Terrain and surface together: slope, relief and ground brightness like the target, plus a harsh climate.

thermal.label: Base and hardware (thermal)
thermal.description: Temperature first: cold days, cold nights and big day-night swings, for testing habitats, batteries and seals.

astrobiology.label: Astrobiology
astrobiology.description: Barren and extreme: as little life as possible, for testing life-detection instruments without false positives.
